derivationRule.anatomy: Preserve the existing component's shadcn anatomy and prop API.
derivationRule.visuals: Choose geometry only from the character's seven workhorse motif laws and component carrier analogies.
derivationRule.motion: Do not apply POWER assemblies or looping character motion to these workhorses.
derivationRule.review: Every entry remains derived until the user approves its proposed motif basis.
